title: Notice for Newly Admitted Students – LMS Portal Login
text:
📢 Notice for Newly Admitted Students – LMS Portal Login

All newly admitted students are informed that their

Learning Management System (LMS) Portal Accounts
have been created.
Please follow the details below to access your account:

Username:
Student Personal Email (used at time of apply)

Password:
123456
(You must change your password upon first login)

Login Link:

eservices.awkum.edu.pk (https://eservices.awkum.edu.pk)

👉 Students are advised to log in at the earliest and update their password for security purposes.

For any login-related issues, please contact the
IT Section / LMS Support
at AWKUM.

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan
